summary: Iteration 3 (MASSIVE expansion) tested end-to-end. Backend: 31/31 new iter3 pytest tests pass covering account-type signup split, location+Haversine, products CRUD with business/personal enforcement, nearby/offers filters, businesses list, events CRUD with going-toggle, auto-created notifications (like/comment/mention/follow), unread-count+read-all, multi-image posts, regex-escape search with products+businesses, denormalised follower counts, nearby/users. Frontend: signup personal/business toggle reveals business fields; notifications bell shows unread badge (e.g. '2' for Rohan); 5-tab BottomNav (Feed/Shops/Post/Events/Me) works; /shops renders OpenStreetMap Leaflet with shop markers, 8 category chips, Nearby toggle, hot-offers strip, shop rows; /events renders Leaflet with event markers, create-event btn, 'I'm in' buttons; /notifications lists notifs correctly. Regressions in prior iteration test files are all legitimate API-shape changes, not bugs.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec requires 'Profile page redirects business accounts to /shop/:id automatically'. Logged-in business user (rohan@demo.com) clicking nav-profile lands on /profile (personal-style Profile with 'EDIT PROFILE' button + 'OFFERS POSTED' counter) — NO redirect to /shop/<rohan_id>. Either redirect logic is missing or the spec intent was a unified business profile. Confirm with product requirement.

issues: React hydration warning: shop-row-{id} is a <Link> (renders <a>) and contains an inner <a href=tel:...> Call button — nested anchors are invalid HTML and throw two console warnings on /shops. Fix: change either the outer or inner anchor to a non-<a> element (e.g. wrap with onClick handler + useNavigate, or render Call as a <button onClick={() => window.location=tel:...}>).

action_items: Decide on business-profile behaviour: either redirect business users from /profile to /shop/:id (as spec says) OR update spec to reflect the unified Profile variant currently shown.
Fix nested <a> in /app/frontend/src/pages/Shops.jsx — shop-row Link wraps a tel: <a>. Causes two React hydration warnings per render.

Iteration 2 regression tests (test_iteration2.py, test_localconnect.py) have 3 failures that are LEGITIMATE iter3 API changes, not bugs: (1) /users/{id}/followers endpoint has been removed (replaced by denormalised followers_count) → test_follow_toggle_and_counts assertion fails because endpoint returns 404 {detail:...}; (2) image_path (singular) replaced by image_paths (array) in Post model → test_create_post_with_image KeyError; (3) POST /posts with empty content now returns 400 (custom) instead of 422 (pydantic) because content became Optional to allow image-only posts. Update these three tests or delete the obsolete cases.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1162 lines — now urgently needs splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/posts.py, routers/users.py, routers/products.py, routers/events.py, routers/notifications.py, routers/upload.py, helpers/geo.py, helpers/mentions.py.
notify() is called via asyncio.create_task inside several endpoints — ensure exceptions inside the task are logged, otherwise dropped mentions/likes will silently fail without surfacing.

process_mentions matches by first-word of display name which is brittle (Aanya Sharma → @Aanya works but @AanyaSharma silently drops). Consider adopting @username handles or matching against normalised name with space-collapsing.
Shops.jsx — nested <a> inside <a> (shop-row Link + tel: link) produces hydration warnings; replace inner anchor with button(onClick=window.open(tel:...)).
LocationPrompt should be dismissable and persistently remembered — verify localStorage key is set so it does not re-appear on every refresh for users who explicitly skip.

/api/products and /api/events allow client to pass arbitrary image_path strings without ownership check — attacker with any uploaded path could claim another user's file as product image. Validate that the owner_id of the file matches current_user.id when referenced.
Search response now includes products & businesses — good — but result shape is a flat dict. For UI filtering/counters consider adding per-category counts.
serialize_user still issues one find_one per user when computing avatar + distance. For /nearby/users and /businesses which can return many docs, batch via $in aggregation.

Follow denormalisation (followers_count, following_count) correctly updated on toggle_follow; ensure an inconsistency-repair script exists (counter drift mitigation if a race condition deletes a user).

success_rate.backend: 100% on new iter3 suite (31/31). Combined: 66/69 (3 obsolete legacy tests listed under action_items).
success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all 5 primary iter3 flows (shops+map, events+map, notifications, multi-account signup toggle, notifications bell/badge) verified. One functional gap: business→/shop redirect.

rca of the issue: Business-profile-redirect: Profile.jsx likely returns the same component regardless of current_user.account_type. A useEffect that checks user.account_type === 'business' and calls navigate(`/shop/${user.id}`, {replace:true}) is missing, OR the spec should be relaxed to allow the current unified Profile view. Nested-anchor warning: Shops.jsx shop-row is a <Link> whose children include an <a href='tel:...'> which React/HTML forbids. Fix: change Call to <button type='button' onClick={(e)=>{e.stopPropagation(); window.location.href='tel:'+phone;}}> or re-architect the row to use useNavigate on a non-anchor wrapper.
